card.name: Protein or volume before status/catabolism terms
card.fires_on: The words protein, volume or central when they come right before a physiology term such as catabolism, losses, status or perfusion. It fires in label text on bone, nutrition and fluid balance.

modes.label: protein before catabolism or losses
modes.description: The word protein used as a modifier in nutrition or bone-matrix statements.
modes.example: secondary to an increase in<< protein>> catabolism, and reduced sex

modes.label: assess volume status
modes.description: The word volume after 'assess' in instructions to check fluid status and renal function before starting a drug.
modes.example: Before initiating STEGLATRO in patients with one or more of these characteristics, assess<< volume>> status and renal function.

card.writes: It seems to promote word starts like 'hem' (as in hemodynamic or hematologic), which suggests a physiology term comes next.
card.plain: It marks a body-measure word like protein or volume that is about to be followed by a term such as catabolism or status.
